name: TikTok Dining SaaS / TTGo APIs for US merchants
summary: TikTok developer docs (last updated **2026-08-04**) publish **Integrate With Dining SaaS** for **US merchants** (and Indonesia): Shop Management (POI claim, certifications, decor sheets, tax), Product Management (create/update/delist/webhooks), Voucher Management (redeem — API-only vs Merchant Portal). Positions TikTok GO dining as a first-party integration surface for Shop food ops — sharpens Never86 Shop love→buy-now wedge beyond Klikit middleware alone. Grader Shop fee stays 6 pending Food&Bev table change. Not Meta FBE; not fee dogfood.
what_it_does: Official APIs so dining SaaS / POS middleware can sync shops, menus, vouchers into TikTok GO / Shop dining flows.
how_competitors_use_it: Klikit and similar middleware sit on these rails for US/APAC restaurant Shop order→kitchen sync.
what_we_use_today: Klikit US Shop food guide watch; TikTok Shop fee carve-out watch; grader default 6%
gap: API surface confirms platform intent for restaurant Shop — operator Shop GTM can cite first-party docs, not only reseller blogs
operator_ask: Auth unlocks still priority. No fee dogfood.
not_this: Not a peer_count change. Not fee dogfood. Not forecasting. Does not change grader Shop % alone.
